items.name: SRuleHealth::CheckRule
items.plate_base: SRuleHealth::CheckRule (PS2 0x20a1f8). Version Tracking BSim candidate; sits between SRuleAmmo::CheckRule (0xb9db0) and SRuleTimer::CheckRule (0xba0f0) as on PS2, and like PS2 calls AIElementController::GetStats then reads the target's health (PS2 SMissionRuleTarget::GetHealth, inlined on Xbox through GetCarpElementTracking).

items.name: TIMER_init
items.plate_base: TIMER_init (PS2 TIMER_init). Starts the periodic game tick (XAPILIB timeSetEvent at the video refresh rate on Xbox). Renamed from Timer_Init to the canonical spelling used by the rest of the TIMER_ family.
